_comment: Project allowlist for the agent routines (AUTOMATION_RUNBOOK §2b) + high-frequency dev tools. Curated 2026-07-08 from a 50-transcript scan; extended 2026-07-09 for the fix-dispatch manager's unattended daily run (read-only git, the /report email POST, journal writes under qa-output/). Extended again 2026-07-09 (pass 2) to close the daily-QA-triage agent's remaining unattended gaps: root-relative node tool paths (the Bash tool runs from the project root, not Elementum_App), read-only host-pinned curl re-probes of our OWN three live endpoints (elementum.life / push / stripe-webhook), the 'git -C <root> log' culprit lookup, and the PushNotification tool for the surviving-finding alert. The email digest goes through node tools/send-report.mjs (a fixed-endpoint, owner-only wrapper) NOT hand-composed curl, per the 2026-07-09 lesson that variable command shapes can't match a prefix rule. Deliberately STILL NOT allowlisted (owner-approved boundary, do not add): merge to main, wrangler/deploy, rm, secret rotation, blanket (non-host-pinned) curl/interpreter patterns (incl. node -e). Fixer-agent worktree mutations (git commit/push to autofix/*) are granted in the personal settings.local.json, not here; only the owner merges to main. Full bypassPermissions is intentionally NOT set so the permission wall stays as the backstop that enforces this agent's never-merge/never-deploy charter. Extended again 2026-07-09 (pass 3, user-directed clearance audit for the daily code-review routine): added the §A9 PowerShell parse-check as a repo-root-scoped wildcard ([Parser]::ParseFile("D:\Elementum\Elementum_Project\*) so the reviewer/triage agents can syntax-check ANY new or edited .ps1 in a diff unattended — this generalizes the two per-file ParseFile grants in settings.local.json. It is read-only static analysis pinned to the ParseFile API (cannot execute a script), with the wildcard confined to the file-path argument under the repo root — deliberately NOT a broadened PowerShell surface. The /report email must stay on 'node tools/send-report.mjs' (never hand-composed Invoke-RestMethod/curl — variable shapes can't match a prefix rule, 2026-07-09 lesson); journal + last-reviewed.txt writes use the Write/Edit tool under qa-output/** (not shell redirects like printf>). Extended again 2026-07-09 (pass 4, autopilot hardening for the daily code-review routine): added ROOT-RUNNABLE forms of its mechanical gates so they never need a cd into Elementum_App (the Bash cwd is the project root) and never depend on machine-local settings.local.json approvals — 'git -C * fetch *' (the routine's step-1 fetch is hardcoded with -C, which 'git fetch *' cannot match), 'node Elementum_App/tools/qa-engine-regression.mjs' (the §2-C4 engine gate; the script is cwd-independent via import.meta.url), and 'npm --prefix Elementum_App run lint'/'run build' (the §4-A1 and §5-P1 gates, run from root; equivalent to cd Elementum_App && npx eslint . / npm run build). The routine prompt + live SKILL.md were updated to invoke these exact forms and to inspect all diffs/reports/files via the Read/Grep/Glob tools instead of improvised node -e/head/cat/xxd/grep one-liners (the remaining source of fresh per-run prompts). Pass 5 (2026-07-13, owner-directed full clearance for code-review + fix-dispatch): Agent tool (dispatch spawns fixers), git -C read forms (diff/show/branch/ls-remote/status/blame) for the reviewer, and the fixer mutation lane — git add/commit anywhere plus push scoped EXCLUSIVELY to autofix/* branches (no rule can ever match a push to main). The true wall is unchanged: no push-to-main, no merge, no wrangler/deploy, no rm, no secrets. A stray local commit to the main checkout cannot reach origin and is surfaced by the next session hygiene preflight.
